notes: Backblaze drive stats Q1_2023..Q4_2025 (raw daily records): models with >= 500 drive-years. Data-centre HDDs and boot SSDs, a proxy for instance-store NVMe. A failure = the drive was removed as failed (data lost). Zero-failure counts use 0.5 events. Triple: drive-year-weighted 5th percentile / fleet rate / 95th percentile.

Backblaze drive stats Q1_2023..Q4_2025 (raw daily records): models with >= 500 drive-years. Data-centre HDDs and boot SSDs, a proxy for instance-store NVMe. A failure = the drive was removed as failed (data lost). Zero-failure counts use 0.5 events. Age hazard per model from SMART 9 power-on hours (models with >= 90% of drive-days with an age), yearly bins merged to >= 200 drive-years; the first bin extends back to age 0 and the last one onward. A machine's age at t = 0 is drawn from the model's drive-day age distribution.

SpotLake daily Spot Advisor band per US 8 vCPU x86 pool -> band-midpoint interruption rate (plan §7.3 reading); unknown days take the pool's mean. The series repeats yearly; every machine of a pool shares one offset (pool-wide reclaim waves). Spot reclaim loses instance store (permanent).
